name: Utah 4-H Teen Summit
what_you_do: A leadership event on the USU campus. It has workshops to build leadership skills and friendships. The cost includes meals, a place to sleep, workshop supplies and a t-shirt.
who_can_apply: All teens in grades 9 to 12 (those who have finished 8th grade).
deadline_text: Registration opens summer 2027. Deadline not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign-up for the 2027 Teen Summit will open in summer 2027. Contact Vernon Parent at vernon.parent@usu.edu or 385-468-4832.
notes: A youth waiver is needed. Check the page for the cost when registration opens.
